stacks.fix: Pick the shims at assembly: measure the gap at each pin with feeler gauges and stack shims from a 0.05-step set so the end play lands at 0.3 +/- 0.05 (T15-shimselect). No CAD change; buy a shim assortment.

stacks.title: Knuckle sleeve running fit on its pin (bronze bush bore vs m6 dowel)
stacks.units: mm diametral clearance (< 0 = the knuckle is pressed onto its pin)
stacks.fix: Use an h8 pin (ISO 2338, 2.986-3.000) instead of the m6 dowel (T16B-h8pin). The bush maker recommends a running shaft of f7 or h7, and m6 is a press-fit size. Buy 3 x 6 bushes (no 3 x 5 bush was found in the catalogue searched [A]; confirm with the supplier) and open the knuckle bore to 6. The worst case of the fix is exactly 0.000 clearance (3.000 pin in a 3.000 bore), so check a few pins and pressed bores.
